About this item

  • 【Snapdragon X Plus Processor for Performance on the Move】 Stay productive wherever you go with the Snapdragon X processor offering 8 cores, 8 threads, and 12 MB L3 cache for responsive multitasking, and up to 47 TOPS of NPU power.
  • 【Qualcomm Adreno Graphics for Enhanced Everyday Visuals】 Enjoy smooth UI transitions, vibrant media playback, and responsive everyday visuals with the Adreno integrated GPU designed for energy-efficient mobile performance.
  • 【Smarter AI Experience with HP AI Companion】 Get more done with local AI features that personalize your experience, optimize performance, and streamline tasks powered by the on-device NPU and HP AI Companion.
  • 【High-speed Memory and SSD】 Multitask with ease thanks to 16 GB LPDDR5x RAM and 512 GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD giving you quick app loading, file access, and boot-up speeds.
  • 【2K OLED Display with Rich Color Accuracy】 Experience cinematic visuals on the 14" micro-edge OLED display with 1920 x 1200 resolution, 0.2 ms response time, 300 nits brightness, and 95% DCI-P3 color coverage.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Truly impressed. Highly recommend.
    I’m genuinely excited to write this review because I really didn’t expect this laptop to be this good. First of all, I got it for around ₹60K, which felt like a steal. The first thing I noticed was how thin and light it is. The photos I’ve shared should give you an idea. Then I started using it, and the whole laptop just feels premium. The keyboard is comfortable to type on and the letters are nice and big. The touchpad is huge—bigger than any laptop I’ve personally used. The screen is another highlight. It’s big, bright, sharp, and almost edge-to-edge, which makes it look really modern. The box says “Previously Pavilion,” but honestly, HP has done a great job upgrading this lineup. It feels much more premium than the Pavilion laptops I’ve seen before. I wasn’t expecting to be this impressed, but this purchase has honestly made me as excited as a kid with a new gadget.

      1 out of 5 stars
      Dead on Arrival. Amazon Denying Replacement
      Reviewed in India on 10 May 2026
      Style Name: 14inch/ 512GBConfiguration: Without HP Care
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I purchased the HP OmniBook 5 OLED (Snapdragon X, 16GB, 512GB) and received it today. The screen was completely non-functional from the very first boot — a clear case of Dead on Arrival (DOA).

      Amazon completed an Open Box Inspection at delivery with photos taken by the delivery associate. Despite this, and despite this being a clear DOA product that has NEVER worked from Day 1, Amazon has refused immediate replacement under their own 10-day replacement policy.

      Instead of honouring their replacement policy, Amazon is hiding behind a bureaucratic technician visit process — adding unnecessary delays for a product that clearly needs replacement, not repair.

      I paid for a brand new laptop. I expected a working product. What I got was a defective unit and a company unwilling to honour its own policy.

      Buyer beware — Amazon's 10-day replacement policy may not be as straightforward as advertised for high-value electronics.

      Update to follow once resolution is received.
